breakdown.description: The given relative velocities/angles imply different axial components, contradicting the statement that axial velocity is constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly identified that the given W2=100 m/s is inconsistent with constant axial velocity. It resolved this by computing Va = W1*cos(beta1) and then adjusting W2 = Va/cos(beta2), exactly matching the ground truth approach. The originally given W2=100 m/s was discarded in favor of the consistent value.
